sources.note: Banpo village built c. 4700 BC, abandoned c. 3600 BC; "represents the first phase of the Yangshao culture (c. 5000 - c. 3000 BCE)"; 5-6 ha ditched; east of Xi'an, Shaanxi.

notes: Yangshao culture of the middle Yellow River; the page and infobox give 'c. 5000 - c. 3000 BC' with three phases: Early or Banpo 'c. 5000-4000 BC', Middle or Miaodigou 'c. 4000-3500 BC', Late 'c. 3500-3000 BC' (renames in 4000 and 3500). Extent: the page says 'The culture flourished mainly in Henan, as well as the neighboring provinces of Shaanxi and Shanxi', 'the Wei River valley in Shaanxi' and names Gansu only in a museum-object caption; it gives no area and no settlement count. The shape is therefore Guanzhong (Wei valley) + Shanxi + Henan + a Gansu disc; whole provinces overstate a culture known from villages, and the page does not say when the spread happened, so one shape holds 5000-3301 (confidence 2 for the year, the region is the dossier's reading). Predecessors: the infobox lists Peiligang, Cishan, Dadiwan and Baijia; the Peiligang and Cishan hand-overs follow their own dossiers. The Dadiwan culture has its own dossier (5800-5400 BCE on the Dadiwan page, 'eastern Gansu and Shaanxi'); the Yangshao gains the Gansu disc in 5000 from nobody (confidence 1, the Dadiwan page says only that 'The Yangshao follows Dadiwan in the local sequence'); Baijia has no dossier and no dates (see counterparts). Successors: Majiayao ('c. 3300 - c. 2000 BCE', 'its western branch') takes the Gansu disc in 3300 (confidence 2: year from the infobox, land the dossier's reading); Longshan ('3000-1900 BC') follows in 3000, as does 'Shandong Longshan culture, considered to be its eastern branch'. Shimao is listed in the infobox as '2300-1800 BE' (a typo on the page, not used). The page contrasts the Yangshao with the Dawenkou only as an 'exchange' that the Dawenkou page dates over two and a half millennia; the east Henan border with the Dawenkou is not on either page, so the Henan and Hebei cells inside the Beixin (5300-4100) and Dawenkou (4100-2600) discs and the Shandong cells of the Cishan disc are left to those cultures and the Yangshao shape shares no cell with them. The Gansu disc is drawn as the 100 km Tianshui disc without the Guanzhong cells, so that no cell is claimed twice. No Cliopatria shape; the page gives no area, so there is nothing to compare.
